title: Better Vanilla
description: Better Vanilla makes vanilla Minecraft, better.
body:
![Description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49a3d4cef08ea0440a36a17c50cbc24e95c566fd.png)
Better vanilla is a Feed the Beast style modpack, it adds so many more features such as:
- More ores
- New structures
- More biomes
- Performance mods
- QOL mods
- Automation
- Better caves
- Shaders
- UI mods
- and so much more!

Better Vanilla makes minecraft fun again, or at least more fun. It makes your vanilla experince better, with 170 mods included from all sorts of catagories! If you have a low end PC, this modpack is for you, it's like FTB, but with better performance! There are way too many features to explain in this discription, so why not try it out?


Please consider checking out more our projects! [![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a5e529d275da4dac8326c4981b73f7e4b84d5e9.png)](https://modrinth.com/organization/eat-the-beast)
